description: Request a structured verification report for a company in the EU/UK (registry status, address, officers where public, VAT/LEI cross-checks, red flags). Pilot service: a human reviews the request and replies with a quote or result (poll get_request_status); nothing is done or charged before you accept. Hypothesis: EUR 1–5 per automated report; EUR 15–40 human-reviewed.

company_name.description: Legal or trading name of the company.

contact_email.description: Email for our reply (recommended; otherwise poll the status URL).

country.description: Country of the company (ISO code or name).

focus.description: Optional: what matters most (e.g. still active? who are the directors?).

identifiers.description: Optional: register number, VAT ID, LEI.

max_price_eur.description: Maximum price per unit you would pay (EUR).

monthly_volume.description: If recurring: expected units per month.

principal_type.description: operator = acting for a person/organisation; independent = no human principal.

name: request_company_verification
title: Request a company verification report
